notes.title: Overdrive Update #3 - Mini-Boss Action
notes.notes:
This time we added some useful stuff like different player colors ːbloonsː and a fun mini boss ːsmokebotː

http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/miniboss.jpg

Here's the changelog for more information:

 Added player colors to in-game UI for better distinction
 Some minor bugfixes in the menu, specifically in the player join screen
 Fixed annoyingly loud noise when skipping the complete screen at the end of each level
 Increased gold output in first campaign level
 Endless Mode: Fixed some issues with blocking slot machine and slot machine UI
 Endless Mode: In co-op mode, enemies won't drop double health anymore when one player has died
 Added a tiny mini-boss at the end of level 3 in order to find out whether further mini-bosses would be desirable


Let us know what you think about the changes ːbademeisterːːlovebotːːlaresistanceː

notes.title: Overdrive Update #1 - Not phoning home anymore
notes.notes:
Thanks a lot to everyone who purchased the game so far, we really appreciate your support ːlovebotː

We received some concerns about the data which Unity is grabbing at the start of the game and of course we've updated the game to not do this anymore:

http://www.chasing-carrots.com/images/nophone.jpg

Changelog:

fixed bugs that occured when opening the Steam Overlay
fixed issues with native key rebinding regarding the Steam Controller
removed Unity hardware statistics data retrieval


Enjoy the game an let us know if you encounter other bugs or unusual stuff ːbademeisterː ːlaresistanceː
